about_me.title: About me
about_me.description:
I turned a passion for technology into a career focused on solving real problems. I build websites, applications, and internal tools that combine a clear user experience with performance, security, and maintainability.

Throughout my career, I have worked with organisations of different sizes and across multiple sectors. That experience helps me fit the solution to each business context without imposing unnecessary technology or complexity.

I aim to build lasting relationships and dependable digital products through close communication, attention to detail, and a clear focus on outcomes.

experience.title: Build lasting and meaningful relationships
experience.description:
Throughout my career, I've been privileged to contribute to a range of impactful projects across several leading companies, each offering unique challenges and learning opportunities. Currently, at Snyk, I refined their cybersecurity products with intuitive features using React & TypeScript, enhancing user satisfaction and product efficiency.
My roles at Navro and Pipedrive allowed me to deeply engage in software reliability and system optimization, implementing robust solutions and comprehensive testing regimes that elevated operational performance.
At NBCUniversal's Peacock, I took pride in ensuring a seamless streaming experience for millions of users worldwide, contributing to a scalable and responsive service.
My journey at Wise was particularly rewarding, as I led the development of an online lottery platform from the ground up, aligning our technical solutions closely with client needs and market demands. This role not only challenged my skills but also deepened my appreciation for collaborative solution development.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Here are some answers to the most common questions I receive. If you have any other doubts, feel free to reach out.

noQuestionFound.title: Didn't find the answer you were looking for?
noQuestionFound.description: If your question isn’t listed here, feel free to reach out — I’ll be happy to help.

questions.question: How long does it take to build a website?
questions.answer: On average, a website under the 'Online Presence' package takes between 3 to 5 weeks. However, the timeline depends on the complexity of the project and the client's availability to provide the required content.

questions.question: What are the advantages of hiring a developer instead of using a site builder?
questions.answer: When you hire a developer, your website is tailored specifically to your business — without the limitations of generic templates. This means better performance, a unique design, improved security, and the ability to scale or add custom features. It also avoids hidden fees, paid extensions, and technical issues that many DIY platforms can't solve.

questions.question: Why don’t you use tools like WordPress?
questions.answer: It depends on the project. For many institutional or marketing sites I prefer not to use WordPress — its templates are often limiting and, in my experience, they don’t offer the flexibility needed for a truly custom build. I default to modern stacks for better performance, scalability, and simpler maintenance. For e-commerce, Shopify is often the right fit: it’s built for selling, payments, and day-to-day store management, so I use it when the project calls for that.

questions.question: Can I edit the content on my website later?
questions.answer: Yes. Whenever applicable (e.g. blog), I deliver the site with a CMS so you can easily update text and images.

questions.question: Do you also provide hosting and domain setup?
questions.answer: Yes. I can take care of the hosting and domain setup for you, or simply guide you through it if you prefer handling it yourself.

questions.question: Will the website be mobile-friendly?
questions.answer: Yes. Every website I build is responsive and fully optimized for mobile devices like phones and tablets.

questions.question: How does the monthly maintenance work?
questions.answer: All websites include a basic maintenance plan at €10/month. This ensures your site remains secure, available, and fully functional over time. It includes continuous cybersecurity monitoring, periodic availability checks, minor fixes, and email support. You can also request up to 30 minutes of updates per quarter.

questions.question: Do I need to pay for maintenance even if I don’t request changes?
questions.answer: Yes. Maintenance covers much more than visible changes. It ensures your site stays online, secure, up to date, and ready to handle any unexpected technical issues.

questions.question: What if I need more updates than what’s included?
questions.answer: If you need more updates than what's included in the plan, I can quote the extra work or you can upgrade to a higher-tier plan with more support time included each month.
